title: Category:Mobs
wikitext:
This category entails articles describing certain monsters ([[mob]]s) that share a common name with several others rather than having a unique name or title. They are different from [[NPC]]s because they are non-interactive, and exist solely for the purpose of being killed. These are the meat and bones of [[PvE]], and permeate the WoW universe.

NOTE:
* Bosses can be considered mobs, but should be put into their own category, '''[[:Category:Bosses]]'''.
* Interactive NPCs should go into the appropriate subcategory (or subcategories) of '''[[:Category:NPCs]]''' rather than this category.
